items.title: The name
items.text: Bought by Gordon Brothers and Hilco in 2008, by Iconix in 2011 for $65.65M, and by ThreeSixty Group in 2016 for $100M. In October 2026 sharperimage.com was selling gadgets under the name.[^11][^13][^14][^15]

items.title: The stores
items.text: Going-out-of-business sales began on May 31, 2008, run by the Hilco and Gordon Brothers joint venture.[^11]

items.title: The company
items.text: The bankrupt company became TSIC, Inc. on July 17, 2008, and kept filing monthly operating reports with the SEC.[^12]

items.title: The shareholders
items.text: Nasdaq suspended the shares on February 29, 2008 and moved to delist them in April.[^17]

blocks.title: Who owned the name

nodes.owner: Gordon Brothers and Hilco joint venture
nodes.what: Buys the trade name, catalog, website and inventory.[^11]
Buys the trademark from Sharper Image Acquisition LLC.[^13]

blocks.source: SEC filings of Sharper Image and Iconix.[^11][^13][^14] We could not confirm that ThreeSixty still owns the name in 2026.
